source.report: Sheldahl and Klimas, Sandia report SAND80-2114
source.title: Aerodynamic Characteristics of Seven Symmetrical Airfoil Sections Through 180-Degree Angle of Attack for Use in Aerodynamic Analysis of Vertical Axis Wind Turbines
source.transcription_note: The CL and CD entries below reproduce the exact Table 3 rows from 10 through 30 degrees used by the candidate builder. Table 3 is hybrid data: its pre-stall and extended high-angle values include computed/synthesized values, so these rows are not all measured. This test-section airfoil and Reynolds number are a proxy; they do not identify the Avanti S airfoil or its flight Reynolds number.

avanti_context.cl_max_source: DATCOM wing CLmax for a thick symmetric section, swept and tapered, flaps up: 0.85 +- 0.10 (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)

candidate_policy.classification: estimated model policy; not a measured Avanti polar or measured separation location
candidate_policy.lift_scale: input aero.envelope.CL_max * (derived finite-wing strip lift slope / input aero.coefficients.CLa) / 1.0971
candidate_policy.angle_scale: lift_scale * (0.11 * 180 / pi) / derived finite-wing strip lift slope

attached_fraction.note: The equation motivates an inverse Kirchhoff-style surrogate. The resulting fraction is estimated policy, not measured separation.

candidate_policy.attached_join: At 8 degrees, preserve the calibrated finite-wing line exactly: CL magnitude = slope * radians(8) + side * offset.
candidate_policy.flat_plate_join: Add 45, 60, 75, and 90 degree rows from the existing CD90 flat-plate law; the 90 degree row is [90, 0, CD0 + CD90, 0].
